model.source: Pi default (settings.json defaultProvider/defaultModel); no model override passed by driver or spec. Thinking comes from the spec/profile when declared, else Pi default (settings defaultThinkingLevel xhigh).

workflow.name: impact-review

agents.scout: project/agents/scout.md: copy of pi-workflow agents/scout.md installed as <ROOT>/.pi/agents/scout.md (project scope) so the user's ~/.pi/agent/agents/scout.md does not shadow the bundled agent

blockers: Known canonical impact risk floor is high.
Impact review does not attest historical source-file bytes; content hashes cover host-supplied control values only, and citations are unverified unless an authoritative byte snapshot is supplied.
Synthesis verdict NEEDS_WORK contradicts required verdict BLOCKED.
Synthesis risk medium understates or obscures the known source risk floor high (regression risk medium).

hostPins.packageRootNote: The project cwd was the pi-workflow checkout itself (<ROOT> == <PKG>; portable paths use <ROOT>). Replay must run with the engine checkout as project cwd.
hostPins.note: Applied by the self-replay test (test/unit/replay-self-consistency.test.mjs in the pi-workflow seam branch): the concurrency env value; rootPathLength = replay project path padded to the recorded absolute project path length (the engine truncates worker text that embeds absolute paths by character count, e.g. output-retry excerpts); replayRoot = replay at this exact absolute path (workers embed absolute paths in outputs whose digests the engine records); projectIsPackageRoot = replay with the engine checkout as project cwd.

callsCompaction: calls.jsonl keeps every effectful call and drops observation polls whose normalized response equals the previous one for the same replay key (tools/compact-calls.mjs; mirrors replay-subagent-api.mjs queue construction). 23331 recorded -> 153 committed; the full portable file lives under internal/raw-recordings/impact-review/.
pathForm: calls.jsonl, run/, subagent-runs/ are the raw capture with absolute host roots rewritten to <ROOT> (project), <PKG> (pi-workflow checkout), <HOME>, <TMP> by tools/make-portable.mjs.

project.location: the pi-workflow seam worktree itself (read-only use; run records written to its ignored .pi/)
project.committed: agents/scout.md only (installed as <ROOT>/.pi/agents/scout.md). The engine reads no other project file for this workflow; the replay runs in the engine checkout (fixture.json projectIsPackageRoot).

taskInput: Workers only have read/grep/find/ls, so the git range b83cc4f..7e813aa is given together with the full diff text of the two files in the runtime task.
